caption: Drop it in water before you crack it. #KitchenHacks #Eggs

beats.shot: extreme close-up on a tall glass of cold water
beats.does: lowers an egg into the glass; it floats to the top
beats.says: Drop your egg in cold water.
Floating means it is super fresh.

beats.does: lowers an older egg; it sinks and lies flat on the bottom
beats.says: If it sinks flat, throw it out.

beats.shot: medium shot on Mara at the counter
beats.says: Fresh eggs are full of air, so they float.

beats.shot: close-up on both glasses side by side
beats.does: points from the floating egg to the sunken one
beats.says: Floating is fresh. Sunk is done.
